page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 16 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and bzip3 decompression, alongside a bottom 10% result in single-threaded gzip compression. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all placing in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, as well as Passmark memory benchmarks, also align with average tier performance.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance represents a standard general-purpose hardware profile. It demonstrates average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations, static web serving, and software compilation. While single-threaded tasks are a bottleneck, multi-threaded workloads such as web serving, basic database hosting, and lightweight LLM text generation with smaller models are well-supported. The lack of local storage requires external block storage integration.
